subject: Crescendo Capital SIG - control mapping & evidence schedule
messages:
From: Dana Lee <dana.lee@crescendo-cap.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@crescendo-cap.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Crescendo RFI - SIG control mapping and artifact list

Hi Jasmine / Ben,

Thanks for taking this. Attached is our initial RFI spreadsheet (tabs: control-asks, evidence-requests). We need a control mapping to SIG v2025-03 and a list of artifacts that demonstrate operational controls (retention, key management, privileged access). Our timeline is tight — we are working toward an internal procurement review week of 5/24.

Top asks:
- Crosswalk from your internal control IDs to SIG questions (explicit references).
- Concrete artifacts for: encryption at rest (key management provenance), backup retention proof, and a sample audit log showing a privileged access change.
- Expected delivery date for an initial evidence packet (zipped artifacts) and a follow-up technical Q&A.

Attached: crescendo_rfi_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with line items).

Would you prefer to handle the evidence via a secure file drop or a one-time transfer to our SFTP? Procurement copied above for logistics.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Lee
Director, Vendor Assurance
Crescendo Capital

Attachment: crescendo_rfi_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crescendo RFI - SIG control mapping and artifact list

Hi Dana — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. We can get you an initial crosswalk and an evidence manifest within the next 6 business days.

Quick notes / proposal:
- Delivery plan: initial crosswalk + manifest by 2027-05-20, followed by a 60-minute technical Q&A the week of 5/24.
- Evidence transfer: we prefer a secure temporary link (encrypted Drive folder with access controls) for the initial packet; if you require SFTP for PRI/procurement reasons we can accommodate — please confirm.
- Team: looping in Priyom (evidence intake) and Karthik (controls owner) to assemble artifacts and confirm retention windows.

Action items on our side:
- Ben will produce a SIG->internal-control crosswalk and attach a PDF export.
- Priyom will generate the evidence_manifest.zip with pointers to each artifact (sample logs, KMS export summary, backup retention report).
- Karthik will prepare brief narratives for encryption key provenance and privileged access workflows.

If that timeline works, we’ll proceed and deliver the crosswalk + manifest by 5/20. If Crescendo needs an accelerated window let me know and we’ll triage priorities.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana.lee@crescendo-cap.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crescendo RFI - SIG control mapping and artifact list

Dana / team — I’ve completed the first pass of the SIG crosswalk and included a short comment column for what evidence will be provided. See attached: redwood_sig_control_crosswalk.pdf. Highlights:

- Control mapping approach: we map SIG questions to our internal control IDs (RI-CTRL-###) and provide an evidence type (doc/log/config) and owner.
- Encryption key provenance: KMS key creation and rotation events (audit entry IDs listed), CMK aliases and creation timestamps. Evidence: kms-key-provenance.json (sample), key-rotation-runbook.pdf.
- Retention: backup retention policy excerpt (retention_policy_v2.pdf) and a snapshot manifest for a sample tenant (backup_manifest_sample.csv).
- Privileged access change: example IAM change request ticket + corresponding audit log lines (redacted) showing the change and approver.

I’ve left a few rows marked "TBD - scope needed" where we need your confirmation on which environments (prod, prod-shared, sandbox) you want artifact extracts from.

Attachment: redwood_sig_control_crosswalk.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

From: Marc Rousseau <m.rousseau@crescendo-cap.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Lee <dana.lee@crescendo-cap.com>, procure@crescendo-cap.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crescendo RFI - SIG control mapping and artifact list

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A couple clarifying Qs (quoted below inline):

> Encryption key provenance: KMS key creation and rotation events (audit entry IDs listed), CMK aliases and creation timestamps. Evidence: kms-key-provenance.json (sample), key-rotation-runbook.pdf.

Can you confirm whether the KMS entries include HSM reference IDs (we need the chain-of-custody for keys that are HSM-backed)? If the sample is redacted, can you provide a proof-of-possession assertion signed by your security team?

> Retention: backup retention policy excerpt (retention_policy_v2.pdf) and a snapshot manifest for a sample tenant (backup_manifest_sample.csv).

For legal, we need to see retention enforcement metrics (e.g., job run history) for the last 90 days and one proof showing an automated deletion. Is there a preferred obfuscated sample you can share?

Also — can you confirm whether evidence will be delivered in a single ZIP (with a manifest) or staged across multiple deliveries? Procurement prefers staged delivery with a manifest for each stage.

Best,
Marc Rousseau
Head of Vendor Risk
Crescendo Capital

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marc Rousseau <m.rousseau@crescendo-cap.com>, Dana Lee <dana.lee@crescendo-cap.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crescendo RFI - SIG control mapping and artifact list

Marc — thanks, and great questions. Answers below with what we will provide in the initial packet (Stage 1) and what we can reserve for a controlled/PSI release (Stage 2).

Stage 1 (deliver by 2027-05-20):
- Crosswalk PDF (completed) and evidence_manifest.zip (stub manifests + placeholders).
- KMS proof: we will include a KMS export summary that shows HSM-backed CMK aliases and creation timestamps. The export contains HSM reference IDs but redacted serials; we will include a signed assertion from Redwood Security confirming HSM provenance and the signing authority.
- Retention: retention_policy_v2.pdf and a retention-job-history.csv with obfuscated resource IDs showing job run timestamps for the last 90 days; we’ll include one sample deletion entry with redactions applied.

Stage 2 (controlled release, requires DPA/NDA + SFTP or signed DR):
- Full unredacted audit log extracts and KMS full metadata (delivered under an evidence sharing agreement).
- If you require on-prem inspection we can coordinate with Legal to arrange a view-only session.

Evidence delivery notes:
- We will stage deliveries. Stage 1 will be an encrypted Drive link and an accompanying manifest. Stage 2 will require your signed evidence intake form and either SFTP or a dedicated ephemeral transfer.

Internal refs: ticket RED-615 (evidence collection), intake runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/evidence-intake/RED-615 (internal link).

I’ll coordinate with Priyom to assemble the Stage 1 ZIP and Jasmine to confirm the Q&A window.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
